title: F169.5 the phone: the overview
caption: On a phone the nine pages move into the header's sheet, the words stand 24 from the edge, and a picture is drawn again to fit. The sequence slides until its own child draws it as steps.

cards.title: F169.5 The phone
cards.text: At 390 wide no page scrolls sideways, the words take 342 of the 390, and a picture's words are the size they were drawn at.

cards.title: The pages in the sheet
cards.text: The frame draws the menu a site hands it in the header's sheet on a phone and in the left column above that. One menu button. Step 2.

cards.title: The words, 24 from the edge
cards.text: Two of three stacked paddings go on a phone, and a long code word may break, so Getting started stops scrolling sideways. Steps 3 and 4.

cards.title: A picture runs down
cards.text: A cards picture says its direction, as a flow does. Running down, each card is a row and the linked ones hang from a trunk. Steps 5 and 6.

cards.title: The figure holds both
cards.text: It asks the engine for a wide and a narrow drawing, and Bootstrap shows the narrow one below 768. Steps 7 and 8.

cards.title: The sequence slides
cards.text: A picture with no narrow form keeps its size in a frame that slides. Step 9.

cards.title: F169.7, a seventh child
cards.text: The sequence drawn as steps down the page. Planned after this one merges.
